title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2607.26057v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) grounds token-level supervision in the student's own trajectory, yet suffers from prefix failure: once the student commits to a wrong reasoning direction, all subsequent generation builds on this deviation, producing misdirected continuations that elicit unreliable supervision and waste compute. We identify a teacher-student continuation asymmetry on failed prefixes, where the teacher tends to redirect while the student continues along the original direction, and convert it into a label-free handoff trigger in Relay On-Policy Distillation (Relay-OPD). During training, Relay-OPD constructs relay trajectories by letting the teacher briefly take over at detected trigger points to produce a teacher leg, after which the student resumes and is optimized on the resulting trajectory. A limited relay budget concentrates intervention on critical early positions while limiting departure from the student policy

translated_title: 传递接力棒：轨迹接力式在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）将 token 级监督建立在学生模型自身的轨迹上，但存在“前缀失败”问题：一旦学生模型踏上错误的推理方向，后续所有生成都将建立在这一偏差之上，产生方向错误的延续内容，从而引发不可靠的监督并浪费算力。我们在失败前缀上识别出一种师生延续不对称性——教师模型倾向于重新定向，而学生模型则沿原方向继续——并将这一现象转化为 Relay-OPD（接力式在线策略蒸馏）中无需标签的交接触发器。在训练过程中，Relay-OPD 通过让教师模型在检测到的触发点短暂接管、生成一段“教师接力段”来构建接力轨迹，随后学生模型重新接手，并在所得到的轨迹上进行优化。有限的接力预算将干预集中在关键的早期位置，同时限制了对学生策略的偏离。
tldr: 针对在线策略蒸馏中学生一旦走上错误推理方向便难以纠正的“前缀失败”问题，本文提出 Relay-OPD，利用师生延续不对称性作为无标签触发信号，让教师在关键位置短暂接管生成后再交还学生，以有限的干预预算提升蒸馏监督的可靠性。
en_tdlr: To tackle prefix failure in on-policy distillation, Relay-OPD exploits the teacher-student continuation asymmetry as a label-free trigger, letting the teacher briefly take over generation at critical points before handing the trajectory back to the student, thereby improving supervision reliability within a limited relay budget.
